title: Sofia the First
description: Set in the storybook world of Enchancia, this is the story of Princess Sofia, an adventurous little girl who is learning how to adjust to royal life after her mom marries the king and she becomes a princess overnight.

episodes.title: S2-E8When You Wish Upon a Well
S2-E16The Princess Stays in the Picture

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x1
episodes_data.description: Sofia strives to become the first princess to earn a spot on her school's flying derby team. Although paired with the overly-anxious horse Minimus, Sofia learns to believe in herself and proves that a princess can do anything.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x2
episodes_data.description: Sofia is put in a difficult position when she struggles to get her village friends Ruby and Jade and her new princess friends to get along during her first slumber party at the castle.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x3
episodes_data.description: Sofia befriends the trolls that live in the cave near her new home but trouble ensues when her father can't let go of his fear of their banging, even when she brings them to the castle.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x4
episodes_data.description: Sofia becomes a sorcerer's apprentice and helps him impress a king with a new magic trick.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x5
episodes_data.description: The Golden Wing Circus is in town and the kids really want to go, but when James accidentally breaks a giant glass window his father was going to surprise his mother with as a result of breaking a castle rule, James and Sofia attempt to hide it while Amber distracts their parents.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x6
episodes_data.description: Sofia helps a shy classmate overcome her fear of speaking in public; meanwhile, Clover makes friends with a dragon.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x7
episodes_data.description: Sofia decides to enter Clover the rabbit in the Village Faire pet contest, but after pushing a little too hard, Sofia discovers a few things about friendship when she ends up unintentionally hurting his feelings before the contest.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x8
episodes_data.description: Sofia wants to win a new handbag from the Royal Store, but first she must pass the test of putting a princess puzzle together, and along the way she learns that when there's a new thing to do, you have to try it.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x9
episodes_data.description: Baileywick celebrates his birthday with his brother Nigel, but it goes terribly wrong. With help from Sofia, Baileywick gets a wonderful day.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x10
episodes_data.description: Sofia attends a royal picnic, but when the pressure of winning causes the other kids to not play, Sofia shows James how to be a good sport.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x11
episodes_data.description: A little witch's hexes cause big trouble for Sofia and her friends. Sofia tries to help Lucinda the witch mend her evil ways. Will Sofia stop the hexes or will chaos have its way?

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x12
episodes_data.description: Sofia and Amber visit Prince Zandar in the kingdom of Tangu but get lost on a magic carpet. Along the way, Sofia and Amber meets Princess Jasmine.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x13
episodes_data.description: Sofia and her Friends go on a daring rescue of their Rabbit friend Clover who is being held by the clutches of Boswell the Magician.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x14
episodes_data.description: Sofia loses the power to understand her animal friends when her magical amulet is captured by the castle Griffin. So, it is a race between Sofia and Cedric to see who can get it first.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x15
episodes_data.description: Sofia wants to go on a hike with her Buttercup troop, but King Roland insists on sending Baileywick, the castle steward, to keep Sofia safe.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x16
episodes_data.description: A new fairy teacher, Miss Nettle, arrives at Royal Prep to teach royal princes and princesses besides Flora, Fauna, and Merryweather. However, Sofia is suspicious about this new teacher's motives.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x17
episodes_data.description: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up! Belle makes an appearance, making her the third original disney princess to appear on the show.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x18
episodes_data.description: When Sofia is selected to host a Royal Prep tea party, Amber encourages her to "think big."

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x19
episodes_data.description: The students at Royal Prep make their own costumes for this year's All Hallows' Eve contest.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x20
episodes_data.description: When Sofia reluctantly agrees to help Aunt Tilly bake a pie, Sofia thinks she's in for a dull day.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x21
episodes_data.description: Sofia helps King Roland see how important his job is as king after he yearns to live a more simple life as a baker.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x22
episodes_data.description: During her family vacation on a floating palace, Sofia arrives ta a special cove and befriends a curious young mermaid.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x23
episodes_data.description: Sofia tries to find a way to convince her parents to move to the floating palace to save the mermaid kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x24
episodes_data.description: A snowstorm prevents King Roland from returning home in time for the holidays. Sofia leads her family on a brave expedition to find him and shows Amber that spending the holiday with loved ones is better than any present. Princess Aurora appears to aid Sofia with a special song.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 1x25
episodes_data.description: Sofia invites Jade and Ruby, her village friends, to join her and her sister, Amber, in the Flylight Pageant, an annual parade of flying coaches.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x1
episodes_data.description: Amber realizes how much her royal twin really means to her after a spell that is supposed to give her and twin James separate birthdays accidentally turns him into a baby.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x2
episodes_data.description: Snow White appears to help Sofia learn the importance of trusting one’s instincts after she suspects that a visiting sorceress is not who she says she is.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x3
episodes_data.description: Sofia must teach Prince Hugo the meaning of teamwork after Prince James gets injured right before the big flying derby race and Sofia gets paired with Hugo instead.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x4
episodes_data.description: After Sofia becomes disheartened that she has to share her mom with Amber and James during their annual Mother’s Day picnic, she asks her friend Lucinda, the good little witch, to cast a spell so that she and her mom can be alone and learns a very important lesson about sharing traditions with her new step-siblings.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x5
episodes_data.description: Sofia meets her hero, the brave but silent knight Sir Bartleby, and helps him to accept his unique voice and woo her Aunt Tilly.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x6
episodes_data.description: Sofia and her friends get overly competitive while participating in an enchanted science fair project and learn that their friendship is more important than winning the fair.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x7
episodes_data.description: With his parents away, James is made king for the day and gets carried away finding fun solutions to royal problems.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x8
episodes_data.description: After becoming jealous, Amber makes a wish into a wishing well that accidentally turns Sofia into a cat.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x9
episodes_data.description: Sofia encourages a young kitchen maid named Gwen to pursue her dream of becoming an inventor.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x10
episodes_data.description: When Sofia finds herself needing to be in two places at the same time, she uses one of Cedric’s magic spells to create a second Sofia, who mischievously wreaks havoc on the castle.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x11
episodes_data.description: Sofia visits a magical retirement home for sorcerers and helps Cedric earn his family’s powerful wand and his father’s respect.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x12
episodes_data.description: On a royal visit to the Kingdom of Wei-Ling, Sofia, Amber and Princess Jun must work together to rescue their fathers and brothers who are trapped in a jaguar’s den. Disney Princess Mulan makes a special appearance to offer some strategic advice to the young princesses.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x13
episodes_data.description: While setting up for a Halloween party in the ballroom, Sofia encounters a ghost set on scaring everyone out of the castle so he can throw his own Ghostly Gala.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x14
episodes_data.description: After a valuable emerald key from the kingdom of Hakalo washes up on the shore of the castle, Sofia and her family must figure out who the key belongs to when two girls arrive, both claiming to be the princess and rightful owners.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x15
episodes_data.description: Sofia and her friends regret their decision to bring their pets to school after Clover and the rest of the animals get scrambled in a sorcery class accident.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x16
episodes_data.description: When Sofia and Hildegard become stuck inside an enchanted painting, Hildegard complicates their escape plan by insisting she knows everything.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x17
episodes_data.description: When a new castle steward named Slickwell puts a curse on Baileywick in an attempt to take over his job, Sofia and Minimus must figure out a plan to get Baileywick back.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x18
episodes_data.description: Amber discovers Sofia’s amulet is magical and takes it without permission, inadvertently summoning an evil princess, Ivy, who’s set on taking over Enchancia.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x19
episodes_data.description: Sofia meets a young faun who has been cursed by an Ice Witch.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x20
episodes_data.description: Crackle would love to sing in the Leafsong Festival but fears that she'll have to give up her fire-breathing ability to participate.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x21
episodes_data.description: Cedric steps in as substitute teacher for Sofia’s sorcery class and helps the students of Royal Prep protect their school after a group of visiting pranksters arrive to wreak havoc.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x22
episodes_data.description: Sofia and Clover learn to be more considerate of others after Clover’s warren gets flooded and Sofia invites him to stay with her, causing friction in their friendship when they realize that they both have very different habits.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x23
episodes_data.description: After teaming up with an over-eager fairy godmother, Sofia’s friend Ruby learns that a little assistance is nice, but sometimes you have to do things on your own.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x24
episodes_data.description: When a game of dazzleball pits the villagers against the royals, Sofia must decide whether to play with her old friends or her new family.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x25
episodes_data.description: Sofia’s amulet grants her the power to become tiny after she helps three wee sprites, but when she disobeys her mother, her good deed backfires and she loses the ability to grow big again.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x26
episodes_data.description: Amber agrees to go on an overnight hike with Sofia and the Buttercups despite her distaste for the outdoors and ends up saving the day when the rest of the troop is trapped by a swamp monster.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x27
episodes_data.description: When Sofia meets her idol, Carol of the Arrow, and joins her merry band of do-gooders, she learns that there are many different ways to help people.

episodes_data.title: Sofia the First 2x28
episodes_data.description: When Clio helps Sofia practice for the upcoming school musical auditions, Sofia recognizes Clio’s own talents and encourages her to audition too.
